facts.note: At dinner, when the temple bell struck nine, Aurèle had each guest bring out a watch; Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall for his cigar case from his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back.
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after Vauthier sat down again.
